verdict.summary: K_1 := hbar L_1(O)^(1)(K_b), the fewest-leg part of the eps -> 0 limit at finite T of the K-route defect graphs (Def c8-K), exists as soon as the limit is local and is the same local functional at every finite T: T d/dT of every special-edge cycle is O(eps) at fixed T. The composite A|_V--c lines contribute finite, local, T-independent terms. At fixed eps the defect log T coefficient is 0 in the two-point action sectors, O(eps) nonzero for the scalar bilinears and along (eta1,eta2); it vanishes as eps -> 0. The flows carry (3/(8 pi^2)) hbar log T times nonzero zero-mode trees, Q-closed, reaching no core quantity. Route (A); K = P^dagger is a cross-check (with an explicit rescaling term if P_1 != 0).

ch08_issues: CH08: remark 'The existence along $K$' (unlabelled, directly after thm:c8-K): (a) its first sentence is a per-graph statement at arity one; summed over the graphs the coefficient of log T at fixed eps is (3/(8 pi^2)) hbar Q of the zero-mode tree at eps, identically 0 in the two-point sectors of the action and O(eps) but nonzero for the scalar bilinears, and along (eta1,eta2) with Gamma|_V != 0 it carries eps e^{-eps|p|^2} (first moment of the cut tree), not e^{-eps|p|^2}-1; (b) existence and T-independence at finite T follow from the O(eps) bound on T d/dT of every special-edge cycle at fixed T, not from the large-T asymptotics; (c) the relations omit P_1, M_1 in the (K_b,P_b') relation and the (eta1,eta2) relation; evidence: k_transfer.tex Thm thm:ktr-defect (ii), Thm thm:ktr-defectlog, Thm thm:ktr-relations; k_transfer_numeric/results.json a_defect_K (per composite graph c_g (e^{-eps|p|^2}-1), c_g = +-9i, +-147/2 i, +-3, +-18 units, total 0) and c_eta_eta (c_eta = -48i, 288i, 0, 48i units); k_judgement.tex Prop prop:kj-defectlog, Prop prop:kj-compare; proposed fix: replace the body of the remark by 'In a graph of the defect along $K_b$ with $S^{(1)}(K_b)$ floating on its cycle, the coefficient of $\log T$ at a fixed $\varepsilon$ is $\tfrac{3}{8\pi^2}\hbar$ times the tree obtained by cutting the insertion out of the cycle and evaluating the freed legs on the constant modes $A|_V=b\otimes X_a$, $c=X^a$, summed over $a$; this tree contains the special edge $K_\varepsilon-K_0$ at a generic momentum $p$ and carries the factor $e^{-\varepsilon|p|^2}-1$. Summed over the graphs, the coefficient is $\tfrac{3}{8\pi^2}\hbar$ times $Q$ of $\sum_a\partial_{A|_V=b\otimes X_a}\partial_{c=X^a}$ of the order-$\hbar^0$ part of $\partial_\delta W(P(\varepsilon,\infty),I+\delta O)$: it vanishes identically in the two-point sectors of the action and is of order $\varepsilon$, and nonzero, for the scalar bilinears. Along $(\eta_1,\eta_2)\in\Sigma^*\times\Sigma^*$ with $\Gamma(\eta_1,\eta_2)|_V\neq0$ the coefficient multiplies the first moment of the cut tree and carries the gradient $-2\varepsilon p\,e^{-\varepsilon|p|^2}$ of the special-edge factor. In every case it vanishes as $\varepsilon\to0$ at fixed $T$. At a fixed $T$, the derivative $T\partial_T$ of every graph with the special edge on its cycle is of order $\varepsilon$, because the edge pinned at $T$ confines the loop momentum and the special edge carries $e^{-\varepsilon|q|^2}-1$; the limit $\varepsilon\to0$ is therefore local and the same at every $T$, which is the existence of the local representative. Three relations constrain $K_1$ on the cohomology of $\Lambda^{(0)}$: the component of $L\circ L=0$ at $(K_b,P_{b^{\prime}})$, which ties $K_1$ to $D_1$, $P_1$ and $M_1$ through $[K_b,P_{b^{\prime}}]=(b,b^{\prime})\Delta+(\text{rotation})$ (Remark \ref{rem:c7-KDelta}); the component at $(\eta_1,\eta_2)$, which expresses $K_1$ along $K_{\Gamma(\eta_1,\eta_2)|_V}$ through $S_1$ and the classical transformations along $\eta_1$, $\eta_2$; and the relation $K=P^\dagger$ of Corollary \ref{cor:c8-gram}.'

f_S and f_P (coefficients of S^(1)(Delta) and S^(1)(P_b) in the arity-one finite counterterms, left free by the two-leg master equation) must be fixed by the arity-two one-loop master equation (dilatation workflow); the prediction d = 0, i.e. f_S = -1/3, from the (P_c,Delta) component of L o L = 0 is to be checked there. A real rescaling p is removable only by a finite part that is not reflection compatible, so in a reflection-compatible scheme K = P^dagger carries the term pbar ad (Cor cor:kj-gram).

Arity-one obstruction along K_b, quadratic sector: only the 1PI special-edge graphs were summed (eps -> 0 limits 22i, -141/2 i, 44/3, 16 units). The one-particle-reducible graphs and the counterterm vertices -Q I^CT(K_b), -{S^(1)(K_b), I^CT}_eps were not added; the T-independent eps^{-1} parts of the first-derivative coefficient, 18i b (A_W) and -108i b (A_V) units, have the structure of the bracket of S^(1)(K_b) with the eps^{-1} mass counterterm (ratio -6 = (u1,u2)), but their cancellation and the decomposition of the finite limits into s F^(1)(K_b) + {S^(1)(K_b),F_0} were not checked.

Locality of the eps -> 0 limit at finite T is proved by the short-distance argument (Thm thm:kj-Tindep (iii)) and tested numerically only in two-leg action sectors (p -> 2p scaling, ratios 2.000000 and 1.000001); graphs with an operator vertex were not evaluated.

Arity two along (K_b,P_c): T-independence follows from the same bound but was not evaluated; the values L_1^(2)(eta1,eta2) and L_1^(2)(K_b,P_c) were not computed (only their T-independence, and for (eta1,eta2) the O(eps) log T at fixed eps).
